verdict.rationale: Sprinto's docs claim continuous monitoring with alerts and real-time compliance posture across integrated systems (docs-3, docs-18, docs-2). Dedicated pages cover Continuous Risk Monitoring, Monitor Access Checks and Integration Monitoring, and integration docs describe automated checks such as detecting users who keep access after offboarding (docs-37). Most of this evidence is marketing taglines and page titles rather than a detailed description of how the checks work. missing for 10: documented test cadence or alert latency proving failures surface within hours, detail on how automated control tests run against connected systems, independent or hands-on corroboration.
